headline_seed: US withdraws B-1 bomber aircraft from UK’s Fairford base amid Iran fears - Al Jazeera
draft_text:
All ~12 U.S. B-1 bombers left RAF Fairford, returning to home stations, Al Jazeera and CNN report. A 25-year-old British-Iranian dual national was arrested Thursday over an alleged plot against the base. Iran denied involvement.

And that's the mews.
